rev6.release_notes: Every number box takes fractions and simple math: 5/32, 1-1/4, 1/2+.0625, 25.4mm. A tool size in a program's comments like 5/32 DRILL is read as inches, 6MM as metric.

cadcam.release_notes: Several parts open at once, one tab each (Ctrl+Tab switches). Every number box takes fractions and simple math: 5/32, 1-1/4, 1/2+.0625, 25.4mm; a box that can't be used says why instead of being greyed. G-code import reads a tool's size from its comment: 5/32 DRILL = .15625, 6MM = metric. Loft guide curves, sweep guide rails and twist, variable-radius fillets, sweep around a full circle. Simulate: Round stock puts its origin at the center.
